browserSearchPath: CLMS Bio-geophysical Parameters, Vegetation, Dry/Gross Dry Matter Productivity
collectionDescription: This dataset represents the total amount of dry matter produced by land plants per unit of time through photosynthesis, without taking plant respiration into account. It is equivalent to Gross Primary Production (GPP) but expressed in kg of dry matter per hectare per day. Global estimates are produced every 10 days at a spatial resolution of approximately 300 m, covering the period from January 2014 to the present.

layers.longDescription: Gross Dry Matter Productivity (GDMP) represents the total amount of dry matter produced by vegetation through photosynthesis, expressed in kg/ha/day.

layers.shortDescription: Quality Flag of the Gross Dry Matter Productivity
layers.longDescription: A per-pixel quality flag (QFLAG) describing the status of the Gross Dry Matter Productivity retrieval, derived from the quality indicator of the input FAPAR product.
